claims.text: Patient reports sleeping well and having no new symptoms for the past 60 consecutive days, from 2026-07-11 through 2026-08-18.

citations.quote: I slept well and have nothing new to report today.

claims.text: Clinician documented lip swelling after the first dose of cefalexin and recorded a confirmed allergy to cefalexin, flagged in the record.

citations.quote: Lip swelling after the first dose of cefalexin. Allergic to cefalexin; documented and flagged.

open_questions: When was cefalexin first prescribed, and what was the indication?
What other antibiotics were tried before cefalexin, and were there prior allergic reactions?
Was lip swelling assessed clinically (e.g., airway evaluation, epinephrine administered) and documented at the time of reaction?
Was an alternative antibiotic initiated after stopping cefalexin, and when?
Has allergy testing or formal allergy documentation (e.g., severity, mechanism) been performed for cefalexin?
Were any follow-up actions scheduled after the allergic reaction (e.g., allergist referral, re-education, EpiPen prescription)?
Which medications were started, stopped, held or changed?
Which follow-ups, referrals or tests are planned or outstanding?
